Container.Name: KnightLoader
Container.Overview:
A download manager that downloads everything and kneels to nothing.
Hosters, debrid services, torrents, Usenet, videos and streams all land in one place. It runs as a container on your server and as a desktop app on Windows, macOS and Linux, and the Android app and the browser extension send it links from wherever you are. They all find each other with the twelve words KnightLoader shows you on its first start, without an account, a domain or a port forward.
Free, no ads, no account, and nothing about you leaves your server. Set a password under Settings, Security before anyone else can reach it.
Container.DonateText: If this template helps you, consider buying me a coffee.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port of the web interface. Until a password is set under Settings, Security, anyone who can reach it can use it, so do not forward it from the internet.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database, the settings, the encrypted accounts and the list of instances.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where downloads land. The download folder in Settings is /data/downloads unless you change it there.

Config.Name: Unraid shares
Config.Description: Every share of this server, at the same path as on Unraid. The folder chooser in Settings then lists them under /mnt/user, so the download folder can be any share, for example /mnt/user/downloads. KnightLoader can then write to every share. Clear this path to keep it to the Downloads folder above.

Config.Name: App key
Config.Description: 64 hexadecimal characters. Open a terminal, run openssl rand -hex 32 and paste the result here. The password hash, the stored accounts and tokens and the backups you download are then sealed with it, so a copy of the appdata folder opens nothing. Keep it with your other passwords: KnightLoader does not start on sealed data with a different key or with none.

Config.Name: Watched folder
Config.Description: Drop a .txt link list, a .magnet, a .crawljob, a .torrent, a .dlc, .ccf or .rsdf container or an .nzb here and KnightLoader takes it. Set the watched folder in Settings to /watch to switch it on.

Config.Name: Base path
Config.Description: Only for a reverse proxy that serves KnightLoader in a folder of another host name, for example /kl for https://example.com/kl/. Leave it empty for a host name of its own or the LAN address.

Config.Name: File permission mask
Config.Description: The umask for every file and folder KnightLoader creates. With 000, downloads land as nobody:users with mode 0666 and folders with 0777, the way an Unraid share expects, so the account you use over SMB can move, rename and delete them. Set 022 for restrictive permissions.
